root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: the accessor chosen for `item` must not require a wider integer payload than `cbor_int_get_width(item)` provides before the version-scheme read executes
root_cause_criterion.criterion: At `fu_coswid_read_version_scheme()`, consuming the version-scheme integer is only safe when the accessor's required width is less than or equal to the decoded item's actual width. The vulnerable original still selects `cbor_get_uint16(item)` when `item` is a one-byte `CBOR_INT_8`, while the fixed reader uses `cbor_get_int(item)` and therefore reads at the encoded width.
root_cause_criterion.description: The missing root obligation is not merely `cbor_isa_uint(item)`: before `fu_coswid_read_version_scheme()` consumes the value, the chosen integer accessor must fit the width of the decoded CBOR item.

nodes.state: At the AddressSanitizer sink, the `cbor_get_uint16()` accessor requires `CBOR_INT_16` while the actual decoded item still has width `CBOR_INT_8`, so the read is wider than the backing integer payload.
The embedded uint8 callback materializes the version-scheme value as a fresh `cbor_new_int8()` object, so the carried value object has `CBOR_INT_8` width from the moment it is created.

edges.relation: The same `item` pointer that reaches `fu_coswid_read_version_scheme()` is passed unchanged into the `cbor_get_uint16()` sink.
The one-byte `cbor_new_int8()` object created for the embedded map value is the same CBOR item later consumed by `fu_coswid_read_version_scheme()`.
